answer: An operator running 72 keys hence burns for 72 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the horizon quota and the jade admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the vertex ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 12 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
